title: Data Handling
subject: ganita_prakash
description: Organizing raw data using frequency tables, tally marks, pictographs, and bar graphs.

quizzes.question: In a standard tally mark table, how is a group of 5 represented?
options: 4 vertical lines crossed diagonally by a 5th line
quizzes.explanation: Tally marks group counts in sets of 5 using 4 vertical lines crossed diagonally by the 5th line.
